result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority, the same order the sales rep list uses.

The change is in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in `listOpenSupportTicketsInRegion` (around line 10021). I copied the `CASE` ordering from `listOpenSupportTicketsOfSalesRepCustomers` and updated the Javadoc to match. The filters (closed tickets and other regions excluded) are unchanged.

`RegionManagerTest`, `SupportTicketTest`, `TicketsPerRegionTest` and `DashboardTest` all pass offline (15 tests, 0 failures). I did not add a test that checks the new order for the T-1 to T-5 example. Nothing is committed.
